title: Amazing day on & in the water!
text:
My 19 yr old daughter and I booked this experience based off the reviews and they did not steer us wrong!

Mario is an excellent tour guide with a true love of Costa Brava and all that the local coves of the Mediterranean Sea have to offer. 

Mario is friendly, organized, and knowledgeable and happily responds to any questions you may have before, during, and after your excursion. 

We were experienced kayakers and snorkelers, but Mario makes sure this experience is safe for everyone. 

We didn't see an octopus but we saw many beautiful fish and couldn't get over how clear and clean the water
author: Amy_A

title: A Perfect Day in Costa Brava
text: This tour was wonderful we had a great time! Mario was very kind and went above and beyond to ensure we had a great day, definitely recommend booking!
author: Brittany_W

title: ⭐️Amazing Costa Brava Trip with Mario!⭐️
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Mario was an amazing tour guide! We had such a great time exploring Costa Brava and kayaking with him. He was extremely punctual with the pickup and drop-off, helped us throughout the kayaking experience, and even took some great pictures of us. He’s very sweet, humble, fun-loving, and made us feel like we were exploring with a friend rather than a tour guide. Highly recommend Mario — he made our Costa Brava experience truly memorable!
author: venusd886

title: A fantastic day for all the family
text: Fantastic day!! Mario is a brilliant tour guide; he was friendly, funny and very informative. The kids thought he was best guide we’ve had on any of our holiday excursions
author: J7293RNpaulg

title: Mad beautiful tour with the best guide Mario
text: The tour guide Mario was a true MVP – very funny, thoughtful, helpful and took care of our safety during the tour wonderfully. The tour itself was spectacular, I will probably remember those vibrant landscapes and vivid sealife for the rest of my life. Totally worth the price. Of course, if you do not want to have the most amazing and wonderful time of your vacation, then this tour is not for you. Otherwise – you must go ☀️
author: 734auritap

title: Don’t miss this!
text: Such an amazing g day.  Small group gave a lot of opportunity to connect and learn lots. Mario is easy going and very willing to to accommodate.
author: Brenda_E

title: Amazing adventure
text: My sister and I really enjoyed the day in San Feliu with Mario. He was really nice and knows an answer to every little question you have about Spain or the ocean. We were not only kajaking, but were also snorkeling and if you wanted to you could even jump off a cliff. Mario also made great pictures to remember the awesome trip. If you are in Barcelona you should totally go on this adventure!
author: lisatS9397AR

title: Small private group for big remarkable fun
text:
The whole experience was just incredible.

Mario only takes in small groups of 4-6 people at a time and as such you get a much better experience and can see some more cozy places than with a bigger group.

Cliff jumping, snorkelling, going in hidden spaces between cliffs…simply incredible!

Thanks again and hope to meet again sometime!

Your via ferrata friends! 🤗
author: horiab992

title: An Unforgettable Kayaking & Snorkeling Experience with Mario
text:
We had an amazing kayaking and snorkeling tour with Mario today, and it was easily one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona. Escaping the heat of the city and spending the day along the beautiful coastline was exactly what we needed.

Mario took us to a charming coastal village, and to our surprise, the group consisted of only four people. This made the experience feel very personal and relaxed. As a solo operator, Mario is the one guiding every tour himself, so you know exactly who you’ll be spending the day with.

From the very beginning, it was clear that safety is his top priority. H
